title: TRICARE Select Terms for Nonparticipating Providers, Authorizations, Eye Exams and Claim Filing
content:
Under **TRICARE Select** the limit a nonparticipating provider may bill above the allowed amount, the service classes that need prior authorization, the referral requirement for specialty care, the routine eye exam interval, the claim filing deadline and the payer order with other health insurance are fixed per tier.

## Terms by tier

The first four columns are the TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers (for example, "Group A (E-1 to E-4)" is TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4)); the last two are TRICARE Select Retiree Group A and TRICARE Select Retiree Group B.

| | Group A (E-1 to E-4) | Group A (E-5 and Above) | Group B (E-1 to E-4) | Group B (E-5 and Above) | Retiree Group A | Retiree Group B |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nonparticipating provider may bill above the allowed amount, up to (percent) | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |
| Service classes needing an approved authorization to be payable | inpatient mental health admission | inpatient mental health admission | inpatient mental health admission | inpatient mental health admission | inpatient mental health admission | inpatient mental health admission |
| Specialty care needs a PCM referral | no | no | no | no | no | no |
| Months between covered routine eye exams | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 0 (not covered) | 0 (not covered) |
| Claim filing deadline (calendar days after the service date, or the discharge date for an inpatient stay) | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| TRICARE pays after other health insurance | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Reading the terms

- The balance-billing limit is a percentage above the allowed amount: on a hypothetical allowed amount of 400.00, a nonparticipating provider may bill the beneficiary at most 460.00 (400.00 plus 15 percent of it).
- A routine eye exam interval of 0 means routine eye exams are not covered on the two retiree tiers; the four TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member tiers cover one every 12 months.
- A claim for a hypothetical service date of 2026-02-10 is within the deadline when received by 2027-02-10, 365 calendar days later.
